summary: Backend only. Ran 85 pytest tests with real authenticated calls (users and sessions seeded in Mongo for customer, business and admin roles): 73 passed (85.9%). Also re-ran the old /app/backend_test.py: 94/95 passed. Those old tests mostly only checked that endpoints return 401 without auth, which is why they missed the bugs below. I FIXED 2 bugs in server.py: (1) the token refresh endpoint returned 500 instead of 401; (2) get_current_user crashed with a TypeError (500) when a session's expires_at was stored as a datetime, which is what the Google OAuth /auth/session endpoint writes, so every real Google-login user got 500 on every protected endpoint. Still broken and reported: POST /api/businesses/register (the endpoint the frontend registration form uses) ALWAYS returns 500; the JWT from business login/register is rejected by every protected endpoint; the frontend calls /api/auth/* verification routes and /api/voice/* routes that return 404; 9 endpoints return 500 where they should return 4xx. MOCKED: POST /api/create-payment-intent does NOT call Stripe (it builds fake pi_ ids locally), and verification emails are only printed to stdout and never sent. Deprecated packages: not checked (backend only).

critical.issue: Always returns 500. Business(**BusinessRegistration.dict()) fails validation because BusinessRegistration (server.py:118) has no state or zip_code fields, but Business (server.py:231) requires both. The frontend form (app/business-register.tsx:219) also sends 'postalCode', not 'zip_code', and sends NO Authorization header, so it would get 401 anyway. Business registration from the app is completely broken.

Both return a JWT access_token, which the frontend stores as 'auth_token' (business-auth-login.tsx:47). But require_auth/get_current_user only accepts session_tokens from db.user_sessions, so the JWT gets 401 on every business endpoint (verification-status, realtime-metrics, verify-email, resend-verification, subscription). The JWT also carries user_type 'business_owner', which require_business_auth rejects (it only allows 'business' or 'admin'). Fix: create a user_sessions record and return a session_token, or make get_current_user accept the JWT.

Returns 500 "Business login failed: 'password_hash'" when the owner email belongs to an existing user with no password (e.g. a Google user). /business/auth/register reuses that user without setting a password_hash, so this business can never log in.

The frontend calls these paths but they return 404. The backend registers them without the /auth prefix (/api/send-email-verification, /api/verify-email, /api/send-phone-verification, /api/verify-phone).

Routes are declared with an extra 'api/' (@api_router.get('/api/voice/suggestions')), so they live at /api/api/voice/... and the frontend's /api/voice/process and /api/voice/suggestions return 404. At /api/api/... they return 500 for Bearer auth because get_current_user(request) is called directly and credentials is a Depends object (AttributeError: 'Depends' object has no attribute 'credentials'). There are 7 such calls.

minor.issue: 500: list(db.receipt_scans.find()) used on a Motor cursor (server.py ~4675). Use await ...to_list().

Return 500 where they should return 403/404/400: a broad 'except Exception' catches the HTTPException. A static scan found the same pattern in about 40 endpoints (suspend/unsuspend, MFA, social, GDPR, etc.). Add 'except HTTPException: raise' before 'except Exception'.
Takes business_id as a query param while suspend takes a JSON body. Inconsistent.
Defined twice (server.py:905 and ~5080). The second one (which revokes the refresh token) is dead code.
MOCKED: no real Stripe call (stripe.PaymentIntent.create is never used). The client_secret is fake and will fail in Stripe's SDK.

integration_issues.issue: business-register.tsx calls /api/businesses/register without an auth header and sends postalCode, not zip_code. The backend returns 401 without auth and 500 with it.
The stored JWT auth_token is rejected (401) by all session-based business endpoints.

action_items: Fix POST /api/businesses/register: add state, zip_code (and/or accept postalCode), precise_latitude, precise_longitude and location_verified_by_map to BusinessRegistration, or default them in Business. Add the 'except HTTPException: raise' handler there too.
Frontend business-register.tsx: send the Authorization Bearer session_token and map postalCode to zip_code, or switch to /api/business/auth/register.

Unify auth: /business/auth/login and /business/auth/register must issue a session_token (insert into db.user_sessions), or get_current_user must accept the JWT. Also align user_type 'business_owner' with require_business_auth.
/business/auth/register with an existing owner user: set password_hash if it is missing. Make login handle a missing password_hash with 401, not 500.
Route mismatch: expose /api/auth/send-email-verification, /api/auth/verify-email, /api/auth/send-phone-verification and /api/auth/verify-phone, or change the frontend paths.
Remove the extra '/api' prefix on the voice and personalization routes. Use Depends(require_auth) instead of get_current_user(request).
Add 'except HTTPException: raise' to the ~40 endpoints that turn 4xx into 500.
Fix receipt-insights to use the async Motor to_list.
Replace the simulated create-payment-intent with a real stripe.PaymentIntent.create, using the STRIPE_SECRET_KEY from env.
Move the hardcoded Emergent LLM key (server.py:58) to the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY env var. JWT_SECRET has different hardcoded defaults in server.py and auth_security.py; set it in .env.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6200 lines; split it into routers/modules.
auth_security.py and mobile_security.py use sync pymongo inside async endpoints, which blocks the event loop.
The email sender is a print-only stub (MOCKED).
No refresh-token issuing endpoint exists (generate_token_pair is never called from the API), so /auth/token/refresh can't be used by clients.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (get_current_user now handles a datetime expires_at; /auth/token/refresh re-raises HTTPException so an invalid token returns 401)
seed_data_creation: Test users (test_*@example.com) and sessions are inserted directly into Mongo by conftest.py and deleted afterwards; TEST_ businesses are cleaned up too. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is MISSING.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: set -a; . /app/backend/.env; set +a; export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2); pytest /app/backend/tests -q. Auth = session_token in db.user_sessions (Bearer). /app/comprehensive_backend_test.py uses stale paths (/api/subscription/plans etc.) and its 404 failures are test bugs, not backend bugs.
rca_of_issue: Token refresh 500: the 401 HTTPException raised inside the try was caught by 'except Exception' and re-raised as 500 (fixed). Google-session 500: datetime.fromisoformat() was called on a BSON datetime (fixed). Business register 500: the request model is missing the fields the Business model requires.
